# Copilot Instructions for FormHook Frontend

- This is a Next.js (TypeScript) admin dashboard for FormHook.
- Use React Hook Form for all form handling.
- Use Tailwind CSS for all styling and layout.
- Use modular structure: components, pages, services (API), context (auth), etc.
- Use Axios or fetch for API calls to the FastAPI backend.
- Follow the API endpoints and features as described in the project README and user prompt.
- Prioritize clean, minimalist, and responsive UI/UX.
- Show loading and error states for all async actions.
- Store JWT tokens securely (prefer HTTP-only cookies, fallback to localStorage if needed).
- Use clear, well-documented code and keep all logic modular and reusable.
